components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The operator's violet pen for the primary action in a task.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--pen); color: var(--pen-ink); font: 600 13px/20px var(--stack-sans); box-shadow: var(--lift-pen); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--pen-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A solid neutral action for secondary or reversible work.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--t1); font: 600 13px/20px var(--stack-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--edge-lit); background: var(--panel-sunk); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Recessed Input
components.description: A field placed into the interface rather than raised above it.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 38px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--panel-sunk); color: var(--t1); font: 400 13px/20px var(--stack-sans); transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--edge-lit); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--pen); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--pen-glow); }

components.name: Active Navigation Route
components.description: A labeled route with a narrow violet location trace.
components.html: Overview
components.css: .ds-nav-active { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--pen-wash); color: var(--t1); font: 600 13px/20px var(--stack-sans); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 2px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--pen); } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--pen); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Disposition Chip
components.description: A written status with a non-color shape channel.
components.html: Open
components.css: .ds-chip-open { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--open-wash); color: var(--open); font: 600 12px/18px var(--stack-sans); } .ds-chip-open svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: currentColor; }

components.name: Record Surface
components.description: The solid primary container for one operational object or dataset.
components.css: .ds-surface { padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--panel); color: var(--t1); box-shadow: var(--lift-1); } .ds-surface h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 15px/23px var(--stack-sans); } .ds-surface p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--t2); font: 400 13px/20px var(--stack-sans); }

components.name: Platform Map Node
components.description: A full-route operational node with a fixed figure and supporting facts.
components.html: Accounts12,480184 joined in 30 days8 blocked
components.css: .ds-map-node { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; color: var(--t1); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-map-node:hover { background: var(--panel-sunk); } .ds-map-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-map-label { color: var(--t3); font: 600 12px/18px var(--stack-sans); letter-spacing: .045em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-map-node strong { font: 600 44px/.95 var(--stack-display); letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-map-fact { padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--edge); color: var(--t2); font: 400 13px/20px var(--stack-sans); } .ds-map-note { color: var(--t3); font: 400 12px/18px var(--stack-sans); }

narrative.overview: Dwelve Operations is a quiet operating desk for a small, expert audience. Its visual world comes from network maps and operations routing diagrams: stable nodes, hairline connections, fixed data positions, and a persistent labeled route map. It deliberately avoids both a glowing sci-fi control room and a generic card dashboard. Most of the interface is solid, neutral, and still. Violet is the live route through the system. It marks navigation state, focus, and primary action; it does not tint broad areas for atmosphere.
keyCharacteristics: Solid surfaces over a plain, cool-neutral application field.
Persistent, labeled desktop navigation; compact top and bottom navigation on narrow screens.
Dense, aligned records with large interaction targets.
Semantic report colors paired with distinct drawn marks.
One restrained live signal, never room-filling glow.

rules.name: The Route Rule
rules.body: Violet means the operator can act or is currently here. It is not decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Channel Rule
rules.body: A disposition always has a drawn mark and a written label or count in addition to color.

rules.name: The Quiet Field Rule
rules.body: The ambient queue trace may warm or strengthen with live load, but never competes with the solid record surfaces placed above it.

rules.name: The Voice Rule
rules.body: Display announces, sans operates, mono identifies, and serif testifies. Do not use a font role as decoration outside its content type.

rules.name: The Twelve-Pixel Floor
rules.body: No functional text is smaller than 12px.

rules.name: The Solid-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Tonal layering and borders establish hierarchy first. Blur is not a container material.

dos: Do use a single continuous surface when several values describe one operational object.
Do make the whole directory or docket row the link and show a distinct focus state.
Do preserve semantic report colors and their drawn marks in every new representation.
Do state destructive consequences and reporter notification behavior beside the action.
Do maintain dark and light themes, keyboard access, and reduced motion together.
donts: Don't reintroduce translucent glass, room-filling gradients, neon halos, or glow on status rows.
Don't turn each metric or field into an independent rounded card.
Don't use case idents as lookup keys or UUID shape to guess a record's domain.
Don't use violet for decoration, or green/red to mean a trend direction.
Don't nest a panel inside another panel; use a recessed well or an internal rule.
